item.title: What Is Functional Programming
item.description: 1. What a Programming Paradigm Is A programming paradigm is a class of typical programming conventions. On one hand, it provides engineers with a way to model entities, linking the physical world to code; on the other hand, it provides engineers with a way of thinking about code and programs.
